snapshot.title: Time Jump — 11:00 AM — UAS-02 Still Unresponsive

fields.narration: It is now 11:00 AM on Sunday, October 25, 2026. The UAS-02 aircraft remains on private property in the Birch Hollow Range. The Calder County Sheriff's Office (CCSO) has arrived and is conducting a perimeter check. The FAA Harwick FSDO has issued a 24-hour reporting requirement for the incident. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has confirmed that the firmware update was not digitally signed and that GCS-01 accepted it without verification. The Aviation Safety Officer has determined that the event meets NTSB reporting thresholds under 49 CFR 800.5 and has initiated the NTSB notification process. The fleet remains grounded. The media continues to report a 'drone in Class C airspace'. The Incident Commander must now decide whether to proceed with a recovery and investigation under the current constraints.
